title: Gets too hot to hold/lift
text: Gets too hot to hold/lift. Gets so hot (even the rubber band) I couldnt drink from it for awhile. Then I smelled AND TASTED THE PLASTIC LID. It smelled like an ele fire. Returning asap.

product_metadata.title: HY3 Reusable Coffee Cup, 18 oz Clear Glass Travel Mug with Flip-open Lid, 100% BPA Free, Microwave Safe, Anti-slip Silicone Sleeve (Blackish Green)
features: [100% BPA Free, No Weird Taste] Our coffee mug is made of durable borosilicate glass. The thermal silicone sleeve and PP lid are Food-grade and BPA-free. It’s free from toxins and chemicals, will not taint the flavor of your coffee.
[Quickly-opening and Dust-proof lid] You just need to flip the cap on the unique design lid and drink from the drinking-hole on it. The dust-proof lid keeps your drinks and the spout clean.
[Microwave Safe and Easy to Clean] Our glass mug is microwave safe after removing the lid. The PP lid, silicone seal ring and sleeve are detachable and dishwasher safe, so it’s very easy to clean.
[Non-Slip, Comfortable Grip] The HY3 glass cup with the silicone sleeve grip is made for both hot and cold beverages. Textured design provides a comfortable grip to prevent accidental slipping.

[Your Everyday Glass Mug] Lightweight, durable, hygienic and simple, our EVERYDAY mug is great for your home, office, or on-the-go, and perfect for your hot or cold beverage, your coffee, milk and tea. It can fit the coffee machine and the cup holder of a car.
